title: Campus Level and Repayment Installments on an Active School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The repayment plan for active accounts' installments follow the campus level of the campus on the student's enrollment record in status enrolled, as held in the district's Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions records, because charges build up faster where meals cost more: two more (2) at Calloway Creek High School or Mesquite Ridge High School, one more (1) at Hollis Middle School or Ridgecrest Middle School, and no change at any other campus or when the student holds no such record. This applies to repayment payments on an active School Nutrition Services Meal Account.

| Campus on the student's enrollment record in status enrolled | Change to the installments |
|---|---|
| Calloway Creek High School, Mesquite Ridge High School | two more |
| Hollis Middle School, Ridgecrest Middle School | one more |
| any other campus | no change |
| no enrollment record in status enrolled | no change |

**Basis questions.**

*Does the meal account's own campus decide this?* No; the campus on the enrollment record in status enrolled does.

*Does a middle school that serves meals at no charge count as a middle school here?* Yes; Hollis Middle School gives one more installment like Ridgecrest Middle School.
